en: The image shows a sepia-toned postcard featuring a large, two-story brick building with numerous windows, surrounded by an iron fence and a courtyard where several people are walking. There are some mature trees inside the fenced area and along the street outside. The architectural style suggests a public or educational facility from the late 19th or early 20th century. Visible text in Cyrillic script is present at the top and bottom of the postcard. The date '30.III 1929.' is stamped or printed at the top right, and the bottom text identifies the place.
